blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Broadcast giant GMA Network Inc. slipped into the red in the third quarter of 2026, with sluggish advertising spending and the absence of election-related placements weighing on its revenues. In a disclosure on Friday, the company said it had incurred a consolidated net loss of P77.36 million from July to September, reversing the P102-million profit recorded in the same period last year. READ: Sans election ads, GMA profit fell 87% in Q1 Quarterly revenues likewise fell by 21 percent to P3.06 billion from P3.89 billion.
